goal.title: Exact quantities and clear English
goal.learningTarget: Apply exact arithmetic and standard English rules to explicit self-contained tasks.
goal.focusAreas: Fraction operations; explicit agreement and reference conditions.
goal.currentLevel: Apply familiar rules at difficulty 2 or 3.
goal.questionDirective: Create three numerical application questions and two English application questions at difficulty 2 or 3. Numerical items use complete exact expressions with varied fraction operations, without stories or hidden domain assumptions. English items provide complete sentences and an explicit editing or selection task: one tests subject-verb agreement and one tests unambiguous pronoun reference. Include every premise needed for one warranted answer. Cover the assigned skills without replacing the English objective with arithmetic.

objectives.name: Evaluate an exact rational expression or explicit bounded condition
Apply subject-verb agreement or unambiguous pronoun reference

goal.title: Standard English in workplace notices
goal.learningTarget: Apply agreement, pronoun reference and verb tense to complete sentence-level editing tasks.
goal.focusAreas: Subject-verb agreement; clear pronoun reference; tense conditions.
goal.currentLevel: Apply familiar grammar rules at difficulty 2 or 3.
goal.questionDirective: Create five self-contained application questions based on distinct notices, messages or brief reports: two testing subject-verb agreement, two testing unambiguous pronoun reference, and one testing verb tense. State the complete sentence and the actual selection or editing task; supply the constraints needed for exactly one warranted answer. Use standard written American English at difficulty 2 or 3. Avoid discretionary style preferences, collective-noun agreement variation and grammatical-label recall.
